name: io.github.casancam/dungeondraft-mcp
description: Read, edit and export Dungeondraft maps; convert Universal VTT (.dd2vtt) into Foundry VTT scenes

environmentVariables.name: DD_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may read and write maps in, separated by ;. Default: your Documents folder

environmentVariables.name: DUNGEONDRAFT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Dungeondraft install folder (contains Dungeondraft.pck), for built-in asset search. Auto-detected on Windows

environmentVariables.name: DD_ASSET_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Dungeondraft asset folders with .dungeondraft_pack files, separated by ;
